items.text: With our basic rights under threat from a rogue Supreme Court, Congress needs to exercise our legal authority to the fullest extent. That's why today we called on @SenSchumer and @SpeakerPelosi to support stripping the Supreme Court’s jurisdiction over abortion. https://t.co/9Rp6RkEqs8

We secured $3 MILLION for Elmhurst Hospital's OBGYN unit!

Elmhurst is a public hospital in Queens and it serves one of the most diverse communities in the world. For too long, its patients haven't had the privacy and comfort they deserve when giving birth. Now, that'll change. https://t.co/xtA53ujMml

Thank you to @RepGraceMeng & @NYCHealthSystem for their partnership in getting this funding through Congress.

Privacy in labor & delivery units shouldn't be a luxury. It promotes recovery, reduces infection & supports bonding. All public hospitals should have these resources.
